interpretation: Under the max-eligible rule BCC flips to ABSTAIN, so the Cancer.cells coordinate would be withheld rather than reported. nonmalignant_RMSE scores all 5,686 spots, including 1,553 with no non-malignant truth mass, and is superseded. The exclusion-corrected conditional RMSE is 0.187631 on 4,133 spots. Neither number is commensurate with the historical eleven-type full-simplex RMSE 0.106347, so the ordering does not rank neighbor rules.
